correctness.rationale: A complete proof reduces all five-letter words to one first-appearance canonical form per 5! orbit and tests exactly the newly created terminal Abelian squares at every extension, preserving all valid prefixes by induction. The finite 297588-node search verifies precisely 205424 full-alphabet Abelian-square-free length-13 canonical words and 14 accepted, each with five singleton witness sets and signatures of multiplicities 8,3,2,1. Two independent code implementations (integer Parikh-prefix differences and direct balanced-block differences) agree on the full 14-word list. Sharp minimum length 13 follows from Evdokimov--Kitaev 2002 Theorem 5. Exhaustive finite enumeration, not sampled experimentation, proves the finite claim.

value.rationale: Extremizers of the sharp \(4q-7\) length theorem are a natural mathematical family, not an arbitrary slice. The result classifies every shortest five-letter extremizer, not just one example, giving 14 complete relabeling classes, 1680 labeled words, and four different unique appended-square forcing mechanisms. These are discrete structural invariants relevant to understanding why minimum-length constructions are not unique; the contribution needs no unproved large-q extrapolation.
